scope: Existing staging testnet. Frozen baseline and candidate SDK assets served only to the test browser. All thirteen backend versions stayed unchanged. No deployment, activation, new resource, or package publication.
method: Sequential baseline/candidate/baseline. Three fresh NEAR-only wallets and twenty-one verified signatures per arm. The candidate shares one fresh access-key observation across durable reservations of an exact wallet/key lane within each recovery pass. It does not cache between passes.

e2e.command: Build the candidate SDK and local Gateway; run passkey.ed25519-yao-local.contract.test.ts with grep "NEAR nonce recovery".

limitations: Three candidate wallets. Sequential samples do not establish a percentile or a guaranteed whole-flow saving.
sdkSigningMs includes automated confirmation, required nonce/RPC work and MPC. It excludes blockchain submission and confirmation.
elapsedToVerifiedMs also includes browser interaction and independent signature verification. Registration includes funding and provisioning. Unlock includes the unlock lifecycle.
Access-key RPC counts cover browser queries during signing, including recovery and fresh transaction context. They are not D1 calls.
Gateway counts cover POST requests overlapping each workload. Lifecycle counts can include background requests.
D1 and Gateway-to-Console counters were unavailable. Null does not mean zero. Browser-to-Console requests were zero.
No Yao protocol, DO initialization, placement or deployed backend change was made. Registration setup variation is not an optimization result.

The local scenario covers three signatures across reload and a transient RPC failure within one unlocked session. Concurrent tabs are not newly exercised; per-lane locks and reservation accounting remain unchanged.

The existing auth.lock path clears durable nonce reservations. An exploratory lock/unlock test reused nonce 2 after non-broadcast signatures 2 through 5. That lifecycle behavior predates this change and is not part of the within-session recovery guarantee.
The independent ECDSA confirmation timeout reproduced on the unchanged baseline in Phase 6R remains outside this NEAR change.

reproduction.build: Public .artifacts/r155b-phase6s/build.py builds baseline and candidate SDKs from source.json. WASM artifacts are unchanged.
reproduction.local: Public .artifacts/r155b-phase6s/test-local.py runs the focused nonce lifecycle scenario with fresh local state. Startup initially lacked a package link. The new test was moved into the existing lifecycle file required by the harness. Test development corrected assumptions that step-up renewed reusable quota and that auth.lock preserved signed reservations. The final scenario directly verifies failed recovery and reload within one session.
reproduction.hosted: Private .artifacts/r155b-phase6s-hosted/run.py runs the existing NEAR-only browser harness, guards backend versions around every arm, and closes its tails in finally.
